sql_calls.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_max_ts,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits) AS audit_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits) AS audit_max_ts;

SELECT 'pos_lines' AS source, bill_ts::date AS date, SUM(qty) AS units, SUM(line_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY bill_ts::date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily_sales', date, units_sold, revenue_inr, NULL, NULL
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY date, source;

SELECT 'shelf_audit' AS record_type, audit_ts::text AS ts, status AS detail, NULL::integer AS units
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_count', count_ts::text, trigger || ': book_before=' || book_before || ', counted=' || counted || ', adjustment=' || adjustment, counted
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_off', date::text, reason, units
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_order', created_ts::text, order_id || ', cases=' || cases, units
FROM store.store_orders
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT
  d.date,
  d.units_sold,
  d.revenue_inr,
  i.book_on_hand_close,
  f.forecast_units_per_day,
  f.book_on_hand AS forecast_book_on_hand,
  f.on_order,
  f.ordered_units,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.status, ', ' ORDER BY a.status) AS audit_statuses
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.sku = d.sku AND i.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr, i.book_on_hand_close,
         f.forecast_units_per_day, f.book_on_hand, f.on_order, f.ordered_units
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT
  p.sku,
  p.name,
  p.pack,
  SUM(d.units_sold) AS bags_sold,
  SUM(d.revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr,
  COUNT(*) AS sales_days_recorded
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.pack;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct,
  MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
  MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00';
